intuition.title: Precursor control
intuition.text: The authors use isolated metal carboxylates to make metal-source composition more reproducible and compatible with nonpolar nanocrystal synthesis. This is source-attributed chemical rationale, not a controlled proof that every route has improved size uniformity.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF pp. 1–4, Introduction and Sections 2–3

intuition.title: Limits of the structural assignment
intuition.text: Powder diffraction identifies source-reported phases but does not supply particle morphology, surface ligands or specimen atomic coordinates. The annealed InP film must remain distinct from its as-made colloid.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
